description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for user-related actions in the Coocook application, including user registration, login, password recovery, verification, and profile display.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::User
classes.description: Catalyst controller class handling user account operations such as registration, login, password reset, and profile viewing.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Initializes user context based on username, finds user in database, and sets it in stash.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays user profile, including organizations and projects, with URLs.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Displays registration form, checks if registration is enabled, and shows terms if applicable.

methods.name: post_register
methods.description: Handles user registration form submission, validates input, creates user, and sends verification email.

methods.name: post_recover
methods.description: Processes password recovery request, generates token, and sends recovery email.

methods.name: reset_password
methods.description: Displays password reset form if token is valid.

methods.name: post_reset_password
methods.description: Handles new password submission, updates user password, and logs in user.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies email address using token and updates email_verified timestamp.
